name: bench dip back arms (form check)
description: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
